QUOTE: Without `MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS`, `MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(member)` expands to `private_##member`, so `ctx->MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(state)` becomes `ctx->private_state`.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer gives the default rename to private_<member>, but never says that defining MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS makes the macro expand to the unchanged member name. It only says the library and sample programs get "real names" or "real field names" with the opt-out, which is not that statement about the macro's expansion.
